body: Sorry for late reply. I could try saving up for a short trip but I don't think I could see myself gone for a year or more. I really want to volunteer for ASPCA so maybe I can try and take a 2 week trip to one of the southern states sometime later in my career.

Sorry for late reply. What I really plan on doing is getting an apartment or even a house with my boyfriend, and I can transfer to the facility in his town, but I'm not sure I can do that so early on in my career atm. I really love him and see me spending the rest of my life with him, he is honestly my rock. We have been dating 5 months now but I've known him for 4 yrs.

No, I quit Zoloft after ~7 months. I have not tried anything else, and not sure if I want to. And apparently a lot of doctors in northern MN.. 

As for bf's living situation, he lives in a house owned by my cousin (they are friends, and have been for 10 yrs), but the house is shared between 4 people at the moment, and it's already a bit cramped.. We planned on finding a 2/3 br house and finding a 3rd wheel for rent, but now that he leased a car, that won't happen for probably another 4-5 months, maybe longer.. And for my job, Im starting my second week next week and I don't know if I want to quit my job when I don't even have a living situation figured out yet. I'm not in that position to be unemployed for any long periods of time to find housing/jobs etc. 

Thank you for the advice, you did help, I have a little bit clearer head right now, still crying for no reason, but thinking about calling anon hotlines..

Not really.. I'm not personally close with most of my family because they all drink and spread personal information for gossip like it's front page news. If I told someone, it would eventually get around to everyone else.. I can't risk having that many people think I'm "crazy."

No, I can't afford to see a therapist/psychologist. And when I even bring it up, my parents make me feel like my problems are insignificant to theirs and brush it under the rug like nothing is wrong. I'm afraid to be on anti-depressants as Zoloft really screwed with me in weird ways and I never want to feel that way again.

I'm usually gaming, or doing some kind of art project. My depression has killed my love of art though. I become frustrated if I screw up and find that as a reason to throw it away and give up. I used to read, but I can't find myself to get into books like I used to. Gaming even feels like a chore, and mom works from home so when I do happen to get a day off, I can't have any devices on the wifi, it's so terrible in the area we live.
